race.description: Celebrate Our Jumps Jockeys 30th October Hcp (C1)
race.comment: CHEF'S KISS (2) is back on the turf after a freshen up of just over 6 weeks, and he will be hoping for some early luck from a tricky gate. A genuine tempo will suit him, and he is capable of having the last say in an even contest. I'M A MACHINE (8) has had a gear change since finishing third here 3 weeks ago, and he will be close to peak fitness. A wide gate will make it tougher, but he is still good enough to win a race like this. SOUTH GEORGIA (13) gets in very light after a 4kg claim, and she may settle closer than usual after drawing her best gate in some time. Keep her very safe. Each way. TOORAK LAD (1) broke through for his maiden win here 4 weeks ago over 1220m, and got the job done comfortably by a length and a half. He cops a tougher gate this time, but an extra 200m will suit him, and he can go on with the job now.
